children: Gupta moves from Tata Power Delhi Distribution after over four years in regulatory and finance roles

Ritu Gupta has joined Noida Power Company (NPCL) as Chief Financial Officer, according to a post shared on her LinkedIn profile. She took up the role in September 2026 and is based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh.

Gupta joins NPCL from Tata Power Delhi Distribution, where she spent more than four years. She most recently served as Head of Regulatory and Finance from December 2024, after working as Financial Controller from June 2022.
Before that, Gupta served as Chief Financial Officer of Tata Power Trading Company between January 2020 and May 2022, before returning to Tata Power Delhi Distribution in 2022.

Gupta's earlier career was largely with Tata Power Delhi Distribution, where she spent close to 17 years after joining the organisation in 2003. Her experience spans finance, regulatory affairs, revenue management, corporate finance, treasury and power trading.

She qualified as a Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and later completed an Advanced Management Programme in Business Administration and Management at the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad between 2022 and 2023.

NPCL is a joint venture between the RP Sanjiv Goenka Group and the Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority. The company serves electricity consumers across Greater Noida, where electricity demand has been increasing as the region expands.
In her LinkedIn post, Gupta said she would bring her experience and learnings to NPCL and contribute to the company's continued growth.

Her move to NPCL marks a return to the power distribution segment after her experience in power trading and finance. Her background includes areas such as planning, budgeting and forecasting, taxation, regulatory matters and financial management.
